decisions.rationale: $14,400 of the funds is a gift from a cousin, and the policy only accepts gifts from close family without defining whether a cousin qualifies; the gift letter otherwise confirms no repayment.
Panel appraiser Prairie Oak Appraisals values the property at $617,000 versus $615,000 price, report dated 23 April 2026.
Employment letter on letterhead has a blank signature line and is not signed by an authorized representative.
TDS is about 45.3% on declared debts, marginally above the 44% limit (GDS about 34.5% is fine), and credit score 748 is strong so an exception may be considered.
